prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset: one dialogue portrait for a gritty low-resolution medieval RPG, actual target canvas 74x100 pixels. Redraw the head substantively, do not crop or filter the full-body source. Input 1 is the character identity only. Inputs 2–5 are Mara, Iwo, Leiya and Tore, style/composition references ONLY, never borrow their identities. Adopt their coarse hard pixel clusters and large nose/cheekbone planes, short neck and narrow collar, imperfect mature face, restrained earthy values. No smooth digital painting, antialiasing, dither, speckle, tiny stray pixels or repeated parallel hair strokes. Conceptually use at most 32 flat muted colors, transparent background, crisp binary silhouette. Large head occupies about 85–90% of height; compact jaw, only 6–9 pixel equivalent collar below, no bust or chest. Entire hair silhouette, ear and rear hair must exist fully inside the source canvas with genuine transparent margin of at least 3 pixel equivalents at top, left and right; collar also separated from bottom by 2 pixel equivalents. DO NOT clip source hair or ear then add padding. Form broad contiguous light, midtone and shadow planes on forehead, broad nose and cheekbone. Very small dark eyes beneath lids with only muted warm-gray sclera slivers, no white flash, no catchlights, no makeup or doll eyes. No labels, text, frame, backdrop, props, hands, jewelry or new scars. Preserve subject identity and age, do not clone the style-reference face.

Subject: Aro, female maintenance-map keeper around age 40. Keep identity-reference warm ochre skin, broad cheekbones, short broad nose, thick low eyebrows, deep brown hair swept in broad heavy side-parted locks, a short braid behind the nape, and the same slightly three-quarter gaze toward viewer left. Mature middle-aged face with firm wide jaw and subtle lower-lid and mouth-plane age marks, never youthful chibi. Expression: settled, quietly attentive and candid, low mostly level eyebrows, small closed mouth with a slight uneven corner, neither generic frown nor fierce anger. Preserve ear/rear braid entirely. IMPORTANT latest character-card appearance overrides old clothing: dark charcoal-brown keeper's long garment, represented by a very narrow dark collar with a tiny worn warm-gray inner edge; remove the old source's prominent olive cloak and wide bulky hood from this tight head portrait. Long garment, hands, map and rope stay outside the frame. Not a nun, priest or grand authority.
